tags.name: Talking head
tags.description: Creator talks straight to the camera, holding or using the product. The classic TikTok Shop review.

tags.name: Voiceover
tags.description: A separate voice recording over silent shots of the product in use (like MenPen). The shots can be re-filmed to match a reference.

tags.name: Demo
tags.description: Shows the product doing its job, start to finish. Proof instead of claims.

tags.name: Before / after
tags.description: Opens on the problem, ends on the result; the cut between them is the payoff.

tags.name: Unboxing
tags.description: Opening the package on camera: first impressions and what's inside.

tags.name: Try-on
tags.description: Clothes worn on camera, with fit, fabric and a few angles or outfits.

tags.name: Party-game montage
tags.description: Cold-open hook, the game's title, then fast card reads and reactions that loop back to the hook (Game Night).

tags.name: Green screen
tags.description: Creator in front of a screenshot or the product page, reacting to it or pointing at it.

tags.name: Skit
tags.description: A tiny acted scene where the product solves the problem.

tags.name: Comparison
tags.description: This vs. that: the product next to a competitor or the old way of doing it.

tags.name: Question hook
tags.description: Opens on a question the viewer wants answered ("why is nobody talking about…?").

tags.name: Problem hook
tags.description: Opens on the annoying problem the product fixes.

tags.name: Bold claim
tags.description: Opens on a strong claim or a surprising number.

tags.name: POV hook
tags.description: "POV: …" framing that puts the viewer in the moment.

tags.name: Cold open
tags.description: Starts on the craziest moment out of context, then shows how it got there.

tags.name: Price hook
tags.description: Leads with the deal: the price, the discount, "under $X".

tags.name: Fast cuts
tags.description: Pauses cut out, about 5 words a second, a cut every 1–3 s.

tags.name: Eye contact
tags.description: Creator looks into the lens the whole time, no glancing off to the side.

tags.name: Captions
tags.description: Word-by-word captions on screen, kept off the product and out of TikTok's buttons.

tags.name: Close-ups
tags.description: Tight shots of the details: texture, tip, label, fit.

tags.name: Cart pointer
tags.description: Says "orange cart" and an arrow points at the product tag.

tags.name: Funny
tags.description: Built around a joke or an over-the-top reaction.

tags.name: Honest review
tags.description: Pros and a con, said plainly. Trust over hype.

tags.name: Hype
tags.description: High energy and urgent ("run, don't walk").

tags.name: Calm / ASMR
tags.description: Quiet, satisfying sounds and slow shots.

tags.name: Relatable
tags.description: Starts from an everyday moment the viewer has lived.
